## A better SMAPI Log
- **Hide Repeats** folds a message SMAPI logs again and again into one line, with how many times. - Earlier SMAPI logs are in the **Log File** menu, next to the latest and crash logs, with **Open Logs Folder**. - **Copy Shown Messages** (⇧⌘C) copies just what the filters show; select lines to copy only those, or **Export Log…** to save the file. - With the Loaded Mods panel open, SMAPI's and the game's versions show as icons (named on hover) instead of being cut off.
